story: Олон голын ус (氵) нэг газар цугларч асар их ус — далай. 每 нь дуудлагын зөвлөмж. 氵+每=海.

prompts.main: Educational illustration for Chinese character 海 (sea), built from 'water' 氵 radical + phonetic. story: Том (大) бүдүүн хонь (羊) — эртний Хятадад баялаг, үзэсгэлэнгийн бэлгэдэл байсан. 羊+大=美.

prompts.main: Educational illustration for Chinese character 美 (beautiful), built from 'sheep' 羊 + 'big' 大 — ancient etymology of a magnificent large sheep. Subject: a SINGLE EXTRAORDINARILY LARGE ram with MASSIVE elegantly CURLING HORNS standing proudly in a mountain meadow, the sheep's SIZE and grandeur are the clear visual emphasis (oversized compared to surroundings). The 'big sheep' reading must be unmistakable. Soft watercolor Studio Ghibli style, centered, no text, no Chinese characters, no watermark.

story: Шинэ загас (鱼), шинэ хонины мах (羊) — хамгийн шинэхэн, ходоодонд тааламжтай идэшний бэлгэдэл. 鱼+羊=鲜.

prompts.main: Educational illustration for Chinese character 鲜 (fresh), built from 'fish' 鱼 + 'sheep' 羊. Subject: ONE whole glistening FRESH FISH on the LEFT side and a piece of fresh tender LAMB MEAT on the RIGHT side, displayed side-by-side on a bamboo tray, both ingredients clearly visible as the freshness pairing. The 'fish + sheep together' reading must be immediate. Soft watercolor Studio Ghibli style, centered, no text, no Chinese characters, no watermark.
